name: The Aardvarks
description: Long-running Lehigh Valley party band that has been playing since the early 2000s. Their sets mix classic rock, funk, soul, punk and current dance hits.
activity: Played Levitt Pavilion SteelStacks Sept 11, 2026; Musikfest Cafe show Nov 13, 2026

name: Eighteenth Hour
description: Bethlehem rock band that writes its own songs in a vintage rock-and-roll style. They have put out seven albums and three acoustic EPs since forming in 2000.
activity: 25th-anniversary show at Godfrey Daniels, Bethlehem, March 7, 2026; new material planned for 2026

name: Smooth Retsina Glow
description: Busy Lehigh Valley band formed in 2019. They have six albums of original music and also play cover sets spanning the 1960s to today, at roughly 200 shows a year.
activity: Won a Battle of the Bands in Dec 2025; on the PA Bacon Fest bill in Easton, Nov 7, 2026

name: Starting Tomorrow
description: Lehigh Valley party cover band formed in 2016, known for mashups across six decades of hits. They are Musikfest regulars.
activity: 2026 schedule includes Musikfest, Rivals (Easton), Phillipsburg Rib Cook Off and PA Bacon Fest (Nov 8, 2026)

name: Co. Spirals
description: Four-piece formed in 2023 that pairs reverb-heavy psych guitar with outlaw-country twang. Their 2026 album is Deep Dark Canyon of Nothing.
activity: Released an album in 2026; on the PA Bacon Fest bill in Easton, Nov 7, 2026

name: Willowbrook
description: Bethlehem indie band that mixes emo with energetic indie rock. They came up through house shows and small local venues.
activity: On the PA Bacon Fest bill in Easton, Nov 8, 2026

name: Higbee
description: Bethlehem band from the Lehigh Valley DIY scene with introspective songs and loud live shows. Their debut EP, It All Falls Apart, came out in 2025.
activity: Debut EP in 2025; on the PA Bacon Fest bill in Easton, Nov 8, 2026

name: Lunar Pools
description: Bethlehem band whose Bandcamp includes the album Subtle Textures and the single Craters.
activity: On the PA Bacon Fest bill in Easton, Nov 7, 2026

name: Lilly Moss & The Steel Ponies
description: Bethlehem-born country singer, about 21, with a strong voice and a high-energy band. She was named ArtsQuest's Emerging Artist of the Year, and her originals have been featured on Spotify country playlists.
activity: Opened for Russell Dickerson at Musikfest 2026; PA Bacon Fest Nov 8, 2026; opening for Darius Rucker at Lafayette College, Nov 20, 2026

name: Me At The Zoo
town: Easton (label base; plays mostly in Bethlehem)
description: Four-piece fronted by songwriter Rob I. Miller, on Easton's Vacant Stare Records. Their scrappy indie and post-punk record Vol. 1 was tracked at the Milford Opera House.
activity: Released Vol. 1 on April 17, 2026; many 2026 shows (National Sokol's in Bethlehem, Funhouse, Frenchtown Riverfest, The Vault in Milford NJ Nov 13)

name: Leadpetal
description: Lehigh Valley alt-rock band with grunge, punk and metal influences that started as a winner of LVGR's Band Factory program. Their debut album, Glass Teeth, came out in April 2025.
activity: Profiled by Lehigh's Brown and White in April 2026; headlined Soft Machine Gallery in Allentown, July 17, 2026

name: Billy Bauer Band
description: A fixture of the Lehigh Valley scene for about two decades. Billy Bauer's original songs pair jam-band grooves with heartland storytelling, and electric violin is a big part of the sound. They also play an occasional Dave Matthews Band tribute.
activity: Played Musikfest Aug 2025; Musikfest Cafe show Sept 18, 2026

name: Hector Rosado y su Orquesta Hache
description: Salsa orchestra led by percussionist Hector Rosado, who grew up on Bethlehem's South Side and has had a long career in Latin music. He also leads a Latin jazz ensemble.
activity: Opened ArtsQuest's Sabor! Latin Festival at Levitt Pavilion SteelStacks, June 26, 2026

name: Craig Thatcher Band
description: Band led by veteran Lehigh Valley guitarist and Martin Guitar clinician Craig Thatcher, performing since 1992. They mix blues, rock and funk, and also do Clapton tribute shows.
activity: On the 2026 Levitt Pavilion SteelStacks schedule for Aug 27, 2026 (also played there Aug 2025)

name: Steel Hemlock
description: Four-piece fronted by a woman, formed in 2023, that sits between country, rock and grunge. They released the EP Pardon the Mess in 2024 and are writing a first full-length album.
activity: Played ArtsQuest's Memorial Day Celebration, Bethlehem, May 23, 2026

name: The Swell
description: Bethlehem cover band led by brothers Travis and Tanner Brown, started during the pandemic and built up through social media videos. They play classic and modern rock, slide-guitar blues and rock and roll.
activity: Played ArtsQuest Center's Williams Brew Stage, May 23, 2026

name: Slingshot Dakota
description: Duo of keyboardist-singer Carly Comando and drummer Tom Patterson. Their big, punchy indie rock has a punk edge, and they have long been a Lehigh Valley favorite.
activity: Opened for Low Cut Connie at Union Terrace Amphitheater, Allentown, May 22, 2026

name: Relapsed
description: Easton metal band that blends melodic death metal, thrash and sludge. They have several albums on Bandcamp.
activity: Most recent album, Take Back the Reins, released Nov 8, 2024; no 2025-26 shows confirmed
